plain_statement: It is false that: The graph: points 0..12, lines 13..25, point p joined to line 13 + l when p + l is 0, 1, 3 or 9 modulo 13 (the plane of order 3); 52 edges, every degree 4, no cycle of length 4, least vertex cover size 13 (by script). Every circuit of AND and OR gates only, each reading at most two wires, every gate counted, true on 26 inputs exactly when both ends of some edge are true, has at least 64 gates, the size of the circuit built from a least cover. Conjecture; the opposite statement, at most 63 gates, is its own row. A finite statement.
title: It is false that: Every circuit of AND and OR gates for the point-line graph of the projective plane of order 3 has at least 64 gates
